newsitem.title: UK: Extra full cargo added to Nov Brent programme - trae.
newsitem.headline: Extra full cargo added to Nov Brent programme - trae.

text.p: November's U.K. North Sea Brent Blend crude loading programme has been revised up by one full cargo to 39 standard 500,000-barrel cargoes and an additional 2.17 million barrels in top-up cargoes, traders said.
Traders said the cargo, due to load November 26-28, was omitted by mistake from the original loading programme released on October 16.
The cargo will pass through the paper chains on Monday, along with another original Nov 26-28 loader and a cargo deferred from the Nov 22-24 period, they said.
Brent Blend, created by blending crude produced from the Brent and Ninian systems, is loaded from the northern Scottish terminal of Sullom Voe in the Shetland Islands.
Brent is one of the world's most widely traded spot market crudes and therefore is used as a benchmark to price many other internationally traded grades.
